summaryZh: Pasquinelli 实验室研究 microRNA 的生成与功能，以及其介导的基因表达调控如何影响个体发育和生存。团队主要采用秀丽隐杆线虫模型，在内源环境中研究 microRNA 的表达和调控作用。
researchQuestions: miRNA介导的基因表达调控如何影响生物体的发育和存活？
miRNA如何在内源性条件下表达并调控基因表达？

evidence.quote: The overall goal of the Pasquinelli Lab research program is to understand how miRNA-mediated regulation of gene expression contributes to organismal development and viability. We have primarily used C. elegans as a model animal system to investigate how miRNAs are expressed and regulate gene expression in an endogenous context.
